content_of_post_to_comment: The older I get, the more impressed I am by people who are really good at ordinary things. The waitress who remembers the whole table's order. The guy who backs a trailer in perfectly on the first try. Someone who remembers your name after meeting you once. There are people all around us who are ridiculously good at things nobody hands out awards for. What's an ordinary skill you can't help but admire?
